newsitem.title: HUNGARY: New bombing outside Hungarian nightclub.
newsitem.headline: New bombing outside Hungarian nightclub.

text.p: A hand grenade exploded outside a Budapest nightclub early on Wednesday in the latest in a series of bombings that police blame on a gangland turf war.
The explosion shortly after 5 a.m. outside the Leroy Country Pub restaurant in the Hungarian capital blew out the windows of two parked cars but caused no casualties, police said.
The bombing follows a spate of blasts outside nightclubs and restaurants and the murder earlier this month of a prominent Budapest gang leader.
Jozsef Prisztas was shot at point-blank range with a 9mm handgun while sitting in his jeep. Police subsequently raided Budapest nightclubs, detaining scores of people.
The Hungarian National Police have set up a 137-strong task force to deal with the gang war.
